    customers = instance['customers']
    capacity = instance['vehicle_capacity']

        dx = customers[cust1]['x'] - customers[cust2]['x']
        dy = customers[cust1]['y'] - customers[cust2]['y']
        return (dx*dx + dy*dy)**0.5

    while unassigned:
        current_load = 0
        route = []
        last_customer = depot

            feasible_customers = []

            prev = c
